name: Sintered NdFeB, grade N45 (example, not reviewed library data)
card:
Example, not reviewed library data. This record is not yet fully human-reviewed and may change in a later commit.

The remanence of sintered NdFeB of grade N45, as one vendor states it for the grade: 1.32 to 1.37 T, in the 'Physical Magnet Data' table of supermagnete.de (Webcraft GmbH), which calls its values 'reference points' that 'apply at room temperature'. The data sheet of the vendor's article W-01-N, a 1 mm cube of grade N45, prints the same range: https://www.supermagnete.de/eng/data_sheet_W-01-N.pdf, page 1, section '1. Technical information', row 'Residual magnetism Br', accessed 2026-10-17.

Neither page states a measurement behind the range, so its origin is 'stated without origin', and its basis is a datasheet's limits. Neither states a temperature in numbers, a specimen shape or a test method. No quote of the vendor's text is recorded, since its terms of reuse were not found.

lot.reason: Grade limits: they hold for the grade as a whole, not for one lot.

temperature.reason: The source says only that its values 'apply at room temperature', with no number.

specimen_shape.reason: Grade limits; the source names no specimen.

test_method.reason: The source names no test method.

n_specimens.reason: grade limits, not measurements on specimens

represents.reason: The vendor calls its values 'reference points' and says nothing of what the bounds represent.

extraction.text_extraction: the text of the page's HTML, saved 2026-10-17
